decision: D3 in docs/DECISION-G1-WITNESS.md is PENDING and requires its own preregistration. This record is that preregistration. It does not implement the repair, does not change an engine file, and does not authorise a run without the owner's decision.
question: Does matched source-frequency decay keep the reference arm alive to the campaign horizon on independent, seed-determined worlds, without breaking the L3 witness or costing early next-cycle recall?

scope.instrument: benchmarks/long_delay_capability.py -- online next-cycle recall@5, k = 5, for the early-cost criterion
scope.burst_excluded: burst_L1 is excluded. Q052 amendment A2 classified its late collapse DIFFERENT_SUPPORT_COLLAPSE, so it is not a second instance of this mechanism and may not be pooled.
scope.why_this_pair: L3 is the adopted G1 witness, where the reference arm is alive at cycle 40; L1 is the campaign stimulus, where the arm first reaches zero at cycle 39 against a 3000-cycle horizon. A repair must satisfy both or it has not repaired the thing the campaign is gated on.
scope.seed_axis: the design's triangle order is shuffled by the seed before lattice_stream, and the resulting stream is rotated by seed modulo its length; the multiset and local triangle structure are fixed, the schedule is seed-determined

mechanism.name: matched source-frequency decay
mechanism.changes: Each cycle, before Layer 1 predictions are built, maintain a per-tag decayed frequency D(tag) = 0.95 * D_previous(tag) + delta(tag), where delta is the increase in memory.tag_frequencies() since the previous cycle and the first cycle starts from the raw counter. Prediction strength uses temporal_count / max(D(source), 1) instead of temporal_count / raw_tag_count. The stored tag counts, the temporal graph, the candidate decay and every threshold are unchanged.

parameter.order: the decayed counter is updated once per cycle, before _build_predictions, keyed on the monotonic sleep-cycle number so a second call in the same cycle cannot apply the delta twice
parameter.scope: the Layer 1 prediction denominator only; no other layer reads the decayed counter

preserves: the admission count and every cap
the retention policy and which structures compete
does_not: change the decay constant, which Q046 already tested at 0.99 and which delayed death to cycle 228 rather than the horizon
change the admission floor or the candidate set
add a budget, a reserved pool or a second mechanism
regenerate or resurrect a belief that formation no longer proposes
mechanism.prediction: On a repeated stimulus the raw source frequency grows without bound while the temporal count decays, so the shipped ratio falls even though the edge is renewed every cycle. Matching the denominator's horizon to the numerator's keeps the ratio near its per-cycle renewal rate, so a re-presented edge reaches the strength rule instead of being diluted by its own history.
mechanism.risk: A stale edge whose temporal count decays no faster than its source frequency can keep a ratio near the renewal rate and remain asserted. The witness and early-recall criteria are the guards, and precision is reported beside the verdict rather than treated as a pass.
mechanism.off_by_one: On the first cycle D equals the raw counter. A tag absent for a cycle decays by 0.95 with no increment. The denominator is floored at 1, exactly as the shipped ratio is.
mechanism.implementation: benchmarks/d3_persistence_arm.py, in-process only; not promoted into the engine, no cell run

control.rule: the shipped engine, no subclass, no-op

treatment.rule: the shipped engine plus the matched source-frequency denominator; no other change

witness.reads: the whole per-cycle theory trace, plus the NO_DREAMS and NO_QUESTIONS negative controls

preflight.reads: the first cycle with zero theories after a positive one; the treatment runs the full horizon

design.cells_arithmetic: 2 stages x 2 arms x 6 seeds = 24 cells
design.pairing: both arms of a seed run on the same seed-determined shuffled and rotated world and stimulus; only the service class differs
design.freshness: the first contiguous window of seven integers at or above 20611101 that appears in no artifact, harness, test, document or journal in the repository; the seventh is the bootstrap seed and is not a world seed
design.world_variation: random.Random(seed).shuffle(triangles) before lattice_stream, then rotate the stream by seed modulo its length; both arms of a seed receive the same shuffled and rotated stream. Six seeds produce six distinct 216-event streams per design; the triangle multiset and local triangle structure are unchanged.

W1_witness.quantity: the treatment's theory cycles and peak on the L3 witness over 40 cycles
W1_witness.rule: at least 39 of 40 theory cycles and a peak of at least 6, on at least 5 of 6 seeds, with both negative controls at zero across the trace
W1_witness.bar_provenance: the adopted witness's measured baseline in docs/tier1_preflight.json, not calibrated on the treatment
W1_witness.on_failure: WITNESS BROKEN: the repair cannot be adopted even if it keeps L1 alive, because it breaks the gate the campaign is verified on

P1_persistence.quantity: the treatment's theory count in the last 100 cycles of the L1 horizon
P1_persistence.rule: no first zero through cycle 3000 and a theory count above zero in every one of the last 100 cycles, on at least 5 of 6 seeds
P1_persistence.bar: 5 of 6 seeds alive at the horizon
P1_persistence.bar_provenance: 3000 is the campaign's own horizon from D2. The 5/6 bar is declared, not calibrated: the campaign requires one live colony, and a majority guards against a single-seed fluke without demanding every seed.
P1_persistence.on_failure: NO REPAIR: the arm still dies before the campaign horizon, so the campaign stays not measurable as designed

C1_early_cost.quantity: next-cycle recall@5 over cycles 5-36, median per-seed gap (treatment minus control)
C1_early_cost.rule: median gap at or above the early-cost bound
C1_early_cost.bar_provenance: Q051's early equivalence margin, carried unchanged; a larger early loss prices the trade and blocks adoption

gates.G1_baseline_death: the control must record a first zero after a positive cycle at or before cycle 60 on every seed; if the control survives, there is no death to repair and the block is void
gates.G2_manipulation_live: both arms must record decay 0.95 and death threshold 0.15; the treatment must record frequency_decay 0.95 and a non-zero denominator update in every cycle; a treatment that differs on the decay constant or never updates the denominator is void
gates.G3_noop_control: the control's structure fingerprint must equal the shipped engine's fingerprint recorded in the run artifact
gates.G4_determinism: the control re-run on the first seed must reproduce its recorded fingerprint
gates.G5_seed_block: the cells must be exactly the frozen 24, with both stages and both arms of every seed and no cell outside the block
gates.G6_denominator: every witness cell must report at least one early prediction, and every preflight cell must report at least one early prediction; a cell with none is not measurable and the block is void
gates.G7_negative_controls: NO_DREAMS must record zero dreams and NO_QUESTIONS zero questions in every witness cycle
gates.void_rule: a failed gate voids the block and no criterion is read
gates.G8_seed_axis_live: the preflight treatment must produce at least two distinct trajectory signatures across the six seeds; if all six are identical, the block is VOID because the seed axis did not vary the measured trajectory

decision_table.reading: the block is unrun; the failed gate names what did not happen, and no criterion is read
the repair damages the L3 witness, so it cannot be adopted for the campaign even if L1 stays alive; the failure is a property of the repair, not of the witness

decision_table.condition: gates pass; W1 passes; P1 fails
decision_table.reading: the arm still dies before the campaign horizon; persistence is not restored, and the campaign remains not measurable as designed

decision_table.condition: gates pass; W1 passes; P1 passes; C1 fails
decision_table.reading: the arm survives to the horizon but loses early ranking beyond the equivalence margin; the trade is priced and nothing is adopted

decision_table.condition: gates pass; W1 passes; P1 passes; C1 passes
decision_table.reading: the arm survives to the campaign horizon with the witness intact and no early cost beyond the margin; adoption is still an owner decision and is not implied by the label

adoption.rule: a pass on W1, P1 and C1 is necessary but not sufficient. Adoption requires a recorded owner decision, a fresh engine pin if the repair is promoted into the engine, and a campaign run under the gate D2 already requires. Nothing in this block changes the engine by itself.
not_authorised: implementing the repair before the block runs
a second mechanism or a parameter sweep of this one
pooling burst_L1 cells into this block
re-scoring a criterion after the block runs
launching the Tier-1 campaign on the strength of this block alone
adoption.withdrawal: A W1 failure withdraws the repair from consideration: a persistence gain bought by breaking the witness is not a repair. A P1 failure records NO REPAIR and this form is not retried; a C1 failure records the trade and the repair is not adopted. Withdrawal is not deletion: the block stays in the record, and a different mechanism needs its own preregistration.

stop_condition: one mechanism, one protocol, one confirmatory block of 24 cells. The record may be fixed if it is found wrong; it may not grow into a second mechanism, a second endpoint or an additional block without a new preregistration.

cost.cycles: 12 witness cells at 40 cycles (480), 6 control preflight cells stopped at death (at most 360), 6 treatment preflight cells at 3000 (18,000)
cost.note: no cell has run; the cost is stated so the block is not opened casually

revision: 2026-11-09: added the explicit success and failure predictions and the withdrawal rule before any cell ran. No criterion, bar, seed, arm or gate changed. Later on 2026-11-09 the pre-flight hook and the in-process arm were added so the frozen block can be re-run against a fixed arm; no criterion, bar, seed, arm or gate changed. 2026-11-10: the seed-varying form was added after D3-PERSISTENCE-1 closed: a fresh seed block, a seed-shuffled and seed-rotated stimulus, G8, and the prior-result section. No criterion, bar, arm or horizon changed; no cell had run when this amendment was recorded.

predicts.success: The decayed denominator keeps the ratio near its renewal rate: L1 stays above zero through cycle 3000 on at least 5 of 6 seeds, the L3 witness holds 39 of 40 theory cycles and peak 6, and early recall stays within 0.01 of control.
predicts.failure: The ratio still falls because the temporal count decays faster than the matched denominator, or the denominator's early value keeps stale edges asserted and early recall falls. Either shows the ratio was not the binding constraint.

prior.defect: all six seeds produced the same per-cycle trajectory, early recall and prediction counts; effective n = 1. The seed was applied to the service RNG, but the lattice stimulus was fixed, so it never varied a world.
prior.reading: The first block is a single-trajectory mechanism result. This confirmation asks whether the repair survives a seed axis that actually varies the world schedule.

not_evidence: This is a seed-axis confirmation of one mechanism on two designs. A pass does not adopt the repair, and a failure does not show that every persistence intervention fails. The original D3-PERSISTENCE-1 result remains the single-trajectory record; it is not re-scored here.
